title: Chapter 888
text:
Somewhere in the Primeval Star River, the fleets sent by the Red Empire, the Radiant Federation, and the Arcane Church gathered. The eleven Beyond Grade As who participated in this operation gathered in the strategic meeting room of the dynasty's flagship to discuss their strategy.

"According to the intelligence, EsGod is currently at this location."

A virtual screen displayed the star map of the Primeval Star River, and a certain desolate region had a red dot that represented EsGod's location. The commander of the dynasty's fleet stood beside the virtual screen and explained the situation to everyone with a serious expression.

The purpose of the three fleets was to deal with the millions of battleships EsGod brought with him, and the commander's mission was to fully cooperate with the Beyond Grade A allies.

"Hmm, that's an ancient battlefield. Many planets were destroyed by the exploration era, and that region is filled with a large number of wandering meteorites."

Manison nodded. He was a big shot in the Primeval Star River and was familiar with the situation in the Star Field.

The only Beyond Grade A sent by the Radiant Federation was Manison. He did not come personally but sent a mechanical shell with three mechanical planetary fortresses that stored a large number of mechanical troops.

Although Manison was only one person, the armed forces he had brought over were not inferior to any fleet. He could almost be considered a faction of his own.

A Beyond Grade A from the Arcane Church knocked on the table and asked, "We only saw EsGod's eyewitnesses.

"We only have the reports of EsGod's troops. Where did this accurate location information come from? Can it be trusted? "

"This is the information provided by the local Supercluster Civilization of the Primeval Star River. They have deployed a comprehensive surveillance system in the Primeval Star River, and after receiving the report, they started to track EsGod's troops. According to the location they provided, we used a star map to verify it. The result is correct, and the accuracy of the information can be guaranteed."

The dynasty commander replied solemnly.

The four Supercluster Civilizations controlled the Primeval Star River and had placed a large number of spies in this Star Field. EsGod's appearance was enough to attract their attention, and under the dynasty's request, they shared EsGod's location and cooperated with it. However, they did not know the details of the joint operation between the three parties.

After locking onto the location, they would be able to rush forward through the stargate network and stop EsGod.

Han Xiao turned around and glanced at them. The three Beyond Grade As sent by the Arcane Church this time were all people who did not participate in the battle on Planet Lighthouse. They were all Psychics, Mages, and Launchers. This meant that there was not a single Esper among the eleven of them.

The more noteworthy one was the Cannon Master, nicknamed "Sun Hunter". He was a member of the Ancient Ones and the strongest of the three from the Arcane Church. He was familiar with the Mecha Empire, Milizaus, and Ravenlaude.

This fellow's body was very pocket-sized, only the size of a palm, but its body was extremely dense. It was an almost extinct race in the universe, and its body had some characteristics of insects. At this time, it was wearing a miniature mecha and sitting cross-legged on the table.

His body was small, but his weapons were mechanical guns and cannons thousands of times larger than him. The contrast was huge.

Han Xiao remembered that Aesop had once reminded him that some of the Ancient Ones were secretly looking for information about him, and this Sun Hunter was one of them.

At first, he thought that this Cannon Master was looking for him to ask him to forge a weapon, but after thinking about it, he eliminated this possibility. The Ancient Ones did not need to ask a new Beyond Grade A Mechanic to forge a weapon for them.

During the meeting, Han Xiao had been observing the teammates sent by the other two parties. There was no need to talk about the Mecha Empire, as he could not see anything from their mechanical bodies. However, the Arcane Church seemed to have a bad attitude toward the dynasty's allies and the Mecha Empire.

Han Xiao still did not know that the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter had been snatched away by the Radiant Federation. The Arcane Church was most angry with the Radiant Federation for taking advantage of the situation. With Ninjia missing, the Beyond Grade A allies under Ethereal naturally would not be nice to the Mecha Empire.

If not for the fact that they had a common enemy in EsGod, the two sides would have fought on the spot.

"Since we know EsGod's location, the initiative of the battle is in our hands. We need a battle strategy," Milizaus said.

"You're right. Although EsGod is a battle maniac, he's not a brute. There's no reason for him not to run when he sees the eleven of us. As long as he abandons his fleet and uses teleportation to escape, we won't be able to catch up to him.

Sun Hunter replied. Although his body was small, his voice wasn't soft at all. It was as if there was a ball of muffled thunder in his chest. With a buzzing echo, the room trembled slightly.

Han Xiao calmed himself down, knocked on the table, and said with a serious expression, "With so many Beyond Grade A combatants participating in this operation, it's obvious that they're not here to do business but to get rid of EsGod. If we want to succeed, there are two problems that have to be solved. First, we can't let EsGod escape as soon as he sees him. Second, we have to reduce EsGod's mobility and make him lose his advantage of fighting and escaping whenever he wants."

Everyone nodded.

Although the three Universal Civilizations had failed to encircle EsGod many times in history, there were very few joint operations of this scale. Some of the Beyond Grade A allies present were only here to accept the mission and did not care about EsGod's life or death. However, if they could not take down EsGod with so many of them working together, it would be embarrassing for them.

Thus, everyone present wanted to complete this mission and get rid of EsGod, the mortal enemy of the three Universal Civilizations.

The Beyond Grade As were resilient, and they had failed many times in history, so they would not have the mindset that they would fail this time.

"The first problem is easy to solve." Manison calmly said, "EsGod won't foolishly fight eleven Beyond Grade As head-on. We only need to split into two groups. The first group will fight EsGod head-on and think of a way to delay him. The rest will lie in ambush and wait for an opportunity to strike."

Han Xiao nodded in agreement.

EsGod was not an iron doll and would not try to fight eleven Beyond Grade As head-on. Although they had a lot of combatants, they definitely could not all appear at once. Otherwise, EsGod would not even be able to fight once he saw so many of them. He would directly leave the fleet behind and run away, leaving the eleven of them behind to do nothing.

"You're right. The first batch of Beyond Grade As has to match the strength of the encirclement without scaring EsGod away," Ravenlaude interrupted. "Therefore, I think four or five Beyond Grade As is a better plan."

"It's best if it's five. EsGod has undergone an evolution, and his strength has increased. He definitely wants to test his strength. Five people should match his expectations," Han Xiao said.

Usually, the strength of the people sent to encircle EsGod was equivalent to three ordinary Beyond Grade As. EsGod's original strength was not a problem for him to deal with three ordinary Beyond Grade As, and he could escape unscathed even if he fought against four or five of them. As for higher level Beyond Grade As, that was another matter. However, as long as he wanted to run, no one would be able to stop him.

With five people, not only could they give EsGod pressure, they could also make EsGod feel that the risk was not high and that there was no need for him to escape.

"Then, the first group will be five people. Three from the dynasty and two from Ethereal. Don't let EsGod discover that the Radiant Federation is involved for the time being."

Everyone quickly came up with a plan.

This time, Milizaus spoke again. "However, if we don't restrict EsGod's teleportation, the ambush will be meaningless. Even if we launch a surprise attack, EsGod can escape at any time. Thus, restricting his mobility is more important. Otherwise, the operation will definitely fail."

Hearing this, the mage from the Arcane Church spoke.

"That's right. The five of us will hold EsGod back, and the work of restricting EsGod's mobility will be done by the ambushers. This will require us to use space magic to envelop the battlefield and cut off the multidimensional and subspace channels in this area. This will temporarily 'separate' this area and cut off EsGod's Dimension Crevice ability. We also have to make spacetime more stable so that all teleportation and hyperdrive abilities will be ineffective. This will turn the battlefield into a spacetime locked area … This is a huge project."

Everyone nodded. This was an effective method to trap EsGod, and it had been proven in history. However, it was getting harder and harder to achieve.

Firstly, this would require a lot of time. The larger the battlefield, the more work it would take to modify it with space magic. Even a Beyond Grade A Mage would not be able to complete it quickly. Secondly, EsGod's alertness was not low and would usually escape before the spacetime locked area was formed.

Even if EsGod fell into a trap, it was not as if he had nowhere to run. He could still use normal methods to break out or use some Esper Abilities to slowly create a spacetime crevice and escape the spacetime locked area.

In this limited time, it was basically impossible to catch EsGod or kill him. He was not a weakling, and his powerful self-healing and defense Esper Abilities would allow him to stall for a long time.

"I have a spacetime stabilizing device that can be activated quickly," Manison said slowly. "It can reduce EsGod's Dimension Crevice and teleportation abilities to a certain extent. It should be able to temporarily lock EsGod down and create an opportunity for the ambush team to enter."

He would be able to chase EsGod away by himself, but EsGod was too slippery, and it would be difficult for him to catch him. All the spacetime locking devices in his hands required some time to activate, and EsGod would have long disappeared.

Furthermore, Han Xiao had rejected his deal, and Manison was not willing to work hard. The Radiant Federation's request did not have much of a binding effect on him, and he planned to cooperate with his teammates.

To put it simply, Manison positioned himself as the controller or support in this team battle and did not want to carry.

Milizaus said slowly.

"If we want to create a spacetime locked area, the five people fighting in the front first have to hold EsGod in one area and not let him run around. We have three Mages on our side, all hiding in the dark. Two of them will use spacetime magic to change the battlefield, and one of them will cover the flow of magic energy to reduce the chances of EsGod discovering them. The people fighting in the front also have to cooperate and make EsGod focus on the battle. We also need a Psychic to attack his mind and confuse his senses."

"We have enough manpower, so it's not difficult to do this. However, this is far from being successful …" Ravenlaude hesitated for a moment before speaking the truth. "If EsGod falls into the trap, we have to get rid of him before he escapes. Otherwise, all our efforts will be wasted. With EsGod's ability, this is very difficult to do."

As soon as he said that, the room fell silent.

Everyone frowned.

Although this was the first time they had the most people encircling EsGod, if they could not solve this crucial problem, it would only be a repeat of history and a new failure.

Just from the discussion before the battle, they had already felt the thorny problem and could not find a solution.

EsGod was very difficult to deal with, and everyone knew that they needed some variables.

Just as everyone was thinking hard about how to solve this problem, Han Xiao took a deep breath.

He had two variables in his hands.

The Spacetime Amber and Esper Silence!

These two abilities could have a decisive impact on the situation. This was also the difference between this operation and the failures in history.

Han Xiao pondered for a moment before standing up and attracting everyone's attention.

He looked around and slowly said, "I have a plan.

"I have an idea …"

…

More than ten days later …

In a desolate universe belt in the Primeval Star River …

After staying near a Star for a few days, EsGod's fleet set off again and moved along the planned route.

After sailing peacefully for a period of time, the fleet's radar detected something abnormal.

A dynasty fleet appeared right in front of them. When the Fallen Ark fleet discovered the other party, the two sides were already very close. The dynasty fleet used stealth mode to quietly approach and only revealed their disguise when they were too close.

The Fallen Ark fleet did not turn around and escape but went forward under Haakisen's orders. Both sides quickly appeared in each other's vision and stopped at the same time, facing each other from afar.

"Woo woo woo …" The alarm sounded and spread throughout all the Fallen Ark battleships.

In the main ship hall, EsGod woke up from his deep sleep and opened his eyes. His gaze seemed to be able to penetrate the walls.

A look of anticipation flashed across his face, and he slowly stood up from his throne.

"It's finally here … I hope I can enjoy it to my heart's content."

…

Another book recommended by PY, titled 'The Second God Kingdom', written by Human Bait.

"Ninety-nine years of compulsory education have taught you how to become an outstanding God. Now, you will enter the true Second God Kingdom. Unleash your strength and defeat all the Abominations. Fight for believers with the Chosen Ones, just like in a simulation game. Do your best, Sons of God! Let the trial of a hundred gods begin! "

At this time, Zhang Fan, who was thinking about how to sleep more comfortably, was confused.
